scope: Synthetic Calc/Fake-X public MCP composition and bounded-cancel accounting

conditions.provider: FakePlanner; one fixed synthetic provider attempt; reported input/output usage
conditions.preparation_order: prepare symbolic task first, then capture observation, mint aliases, and immediately submit compiled call
conditions.stale_policy: unchanged; stale aliases remain rejected; no retries or replay

test_integrity_repairs: Outer accounting wrapper now rethrows inner Calc test exceptions instead of silently reporting green.
If stale rejection occurs before a pending call ID exists, finally now skips terminal polling and still captures diagnostics/closes the owner.
Diagnostic mode assigns one unique run ID and server root; Fake-X state, point resolutions, cancel receipt, boundary snapshot and close receipt are collected under that run directory.
excluded_exploratory_runs: freshness-5000-normal.log and artifacts-freshness-5000-normal: initial diagnostic edit targeted the wrong test body
freshness-5000-normal-corrected.log and artifacts-freshness-5000-normal-corrected: paired call/report/artifact association was incomplete
freshness-5000-optimized.log and artifacts-freshness-5000-optimized: not condition-matched with the normal exploratory capture
reordered-normal.log and artifacts-reordered-normal: early trial before wrapper exception propagation was repaired
reordered-optimized.log and artifacts-reordered-optimized: standalone historical run; not pooled with the final paired run
runid-optimized.log and artifacts-runid-optimized: stale pre-dispatch reproduction that led to the cleanup fix
interpretation: The paired test contract passes in both interpreter modes and demonstrates safe UNKNOWN/replay-denied cancellation behavior. Both retained cancellation receipts show an independent empty Fake-X readback but deliberately do not set the custody-bound release_confirmed bit. This does not pass recovery/release reliability.
next_gate: Explain and verify the product-level evidence required to promote a post-retirement independent readback into a release receipt, or retain UNKNOWN if the missing proof is material. Then test late-operation fencing and task-effect adjudication separately.

supervisor_contract_audit.conclusion: empty independent readback is a stage receipt; no custody-bound release confirmation exists without queue-drain and owner-exclusive physical-state proof
